```csharp title="C#"

using LiterLlm;

await foreach (var chunk in client.ChatStreamAsync(new ChatCompletionRequest { Messages = new List<Message>() { JsonSerializer.Deserialize<Message>("{\"content\":\"Say nothing\",\"role\":\"user\"}", ConfigOptions)! }, Model = "gpt-4", Stream = true }))
```
